articles.title: OpenAI, not yet public, raises $3B from retail investors in monster $122B fund raise
articles.summary: OpenAI's latest funding round, led by Amazon, Nvidia, and SoftBank, values the AI lab at $852 billion as it nears an IPO.

articles.title: Yupp shuts down after raising $33M from a16z crypto’s Chris Dixon
articles.summary: Less than a year after launching, with checks from some of the biggest names in Silicon Valley, crowdsourced AI model feedback startup Yupp is closing its business, the company said Tuesday.

articles.title: Alexa+ gets new food ordering experiences with Uber Eats and Grubhub
articles.summary: You can now order from Uber Eats and Grubhub using Alexa+, an experience Amazon says will be similar to chatting with a waiter at a restaurant or placing an order at a drive-thru.

articles.title: Nomadic raises $8.4 million to wrangle the data pouring off autonomous vehicles
articles.summary: The company turns footage from robots into structured, searchable datasets with a deep learning model.

articles.title: Exclusive: Runway launches $10M fund, Builders program to support early-stage AI startups
articles.summary: Runway is launching a $10 million fund and startup program to back companies building with its AI video models, as it pushes toward interactive, real-time “video intelligence” applications.

articles.title: With its new app store, Ring bets on AI to go beyond home security
articles.summary: Ring's app store will allow the company to target broader use cases beyond security, like elder care or business needs.

articles.title: 15% of Americans say they’d be willing to work for an AI boss, according to new poll
articles.summary: According to a Quinnipiac University poll, 15% of Americans say they'd be willing to have a job where their direct supervisor was an AI program that assigned tasks and set schedules.

articles.title: Popular AI gateway startup LiteLLM ditches controversial startup Delve
articles.summary: LiteLLM had obtained two security compliance certifications via Delve and fell victim to some horrific credential-stealing malware last week.

articles.title: As more Americans adopt AI tools, fewer say they can trust the results
articles.summary: AI adoption is rising in the U.S., but trust remains low, with most Americans concerned about transparency, regulation, and the technology’s broader societal impact, according to a new Quinnipiac poll.

articles.title: Mantis Biotech is making ‘digital twins’ of humans to help solve medicine’s data availability problem
articles.summary: Mantis takes disparate sources of data to make synthetic datasets that can be used to build so-called "digital twins" of the human body, representing anatomy, physiology and behavior.

articles.title: ScaleOps raises $130M to improve computing efficiency amid AI demand
articles.summary: ScaleOps just raised $130M to tackle GPU shortages and soaring AI cloud costs by automating infrastructure in real time.

articles.title: AI chip startup Rebellions raises $400 million at $2.3B valuation in pre-IPO round
articles.summary: The startup, which is planning to go public later this year, designs chips specifically for AI inference, another challenger to Nvidia's dominance.

articles.title: Mistral AI raises $830M in debt to set up a data center near Paris
articles.summary: Mistral aims to start operating the data center by the second quarter of 2026.

articles.title: Qodo raises $70M for code verification as AI coding scales
articles.summary: As AI floods software development with code, Qodo is betting the real challenge is making sure it actually works.

articles.title: Starcloud raises $170 million Series A to build data centers in space
articles.summary: Starcloud becomes the fastest Y Combinator startup to reach unicorn status, just 17 months after demo day.

articles.title: Why OpenAI really shut down Sora
articles.summary: OpenAI's decision last week to shut down Sora, its AI video-generation tool, just six months after releasing it to the public, raised immediate suspicions. The app had invited users to upload their own faces — so was this some kind of elaborate data grab?

articles.title: Sora’s shutdown could be a reality check moment for AI video
articles.summary: Is this just normal corporate strategy, or are we about to see a broader pullback on AI-generated video?

articles.title: Bluesky leans into AI with Attie, an app for building custom feeds
articles.summary: Bluesky’s new app Attie uses AI to help people build custom feeds the open social networking protocol atproto.

articles.title: Stanford study outlines dangers of asking AI chatbots for personal advice
articles.summary: While there’s been plenty of debate about AI sycophancy, a new study by Stanford computer scientists attempts to measure how harmful that tendency might be.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s last co-founder reportedly leaves xAI
articles.summary: All but two of Musk's 11 xAI co-founders departed before this week.

articles.title: Ericsson scores VTel Wireless 5G Standalone deal in US
articles.summary: The vendor will provide VTel with its RAN and 5G Core

articles.title: CoreWeave secures $8.5bn loan for GPU purchases
articles.summary: Reportedly backed by Meta deal signed last year

articles.title: DigitalBridge JV acquires NEC data centers in Japan
articles.summary: NEC divests two data centers to DigitalBridge partnership alongside JEXI

articles.title: How IT infrastructure gives Formula 1 world champions McLaren the drive to succeed
articles.summary: A strong digital backbone has helped put Lando Norris and his team in pole position

articles.title: Hyperscale Data purchases 48.5 acres in southwest Michigan to expand data center campus
articles.summary: Purchase more than doubles company’s acreage in the area

articles.title: TierPoint CEO Jerry Kent to step down, company on hunt for new chief exec
articles.summary: Kent to become executive chairman once replacement found

articles.title: UK's competition watchdog launches SMS investigation into Microsoft, AWS avoids further scrutiny
articles.summary: Lastest update shared on the Cloud Services Market Investigation

articles.title: Ericsson, Nokia secure fresh network 5G contracts with Virgin Media O2
articles.summary: Ericsson will "power" approximately 55 percent of the network, with Nokia covering the rest

articles.title: Enterprise technology and software firm Sagtec Global to build sovereign AI data center
articles.summary: Development to take place through subsidiary CL Technologies

articles.title: London Stock Exchange opts for Dell Technologies for on-prem infrastructure and private cloud platform
articles.summary: LSEG further embraces multicloud

articles.title: Planning decision on Rochelle, Illinois, data center postponed
articles.summary: Unclear when proposal will be considered again

articles.title: Amazon purchases 1,300 acres in Morrow County, Oregon
articles.summary: Could be for 1GW data center project

articles.title: Switch buys more land at industrial park outside Las Vegas
articles.summary: Now owns 300 acres

articles.title: $5.72bn Russian LEO constellation launches first satellites to build Starlink competitor
articles.summary: Russia joins worldwide bid for sovereign LEO, with unlikely hopes to operate by 2027

articles.summary: Building for the future

articles.title: Quantum startup Alice & Bob partners with LANL and others for $3.9m rare-earth-free permanent magnet project
articles.summary: Funding awarded under DOE’s Quantum Computing for Computational Chemistry program

articles.title: Microsoft commits $1bn to cloud and AI infrastructure in Thailand
articles.summary: Company has been planning a cloud region in the country since 2024

articles.title: Sponsored: Beyond PUE: Rethinking how data center sustainability is measured
articles.summary: Three essential metrics to help data center managers measure sustainability success via a more complete and comparative framework

articles.title: Nvidia invests $2bn in Marvell as part of wider NVLink Fusion deal
articles.summary: Agreement will see chipmaker Marvell provide custom XPUs and collaborate on optical interconnect and silicon photonics

articles.title: Forecast uncertainty tempers a banner 2025 for US energy storage: reports
articles.summary: Uncertainty around future load growth, federal guidance on foreign-sourced battery materials and other policy issues could shift deployment up to 52 GW by 2031, Wood Mackenzie said last week.

articles.title: AI data centers are stressing power infrastructure. Storage is the answer.
articles.summary: No one wants to admit that a power system designed for normal data center behavior is struggling under AI behavior, writes TerraFlow Energy Chief Marketing Officer Amanda Simonian.

articles.title: ArcLight in deal to buy 2.2 GW from InfraBridge, mainly gas
articles.summary: The transaction would give the private equity firm an additional 1.1 GW in the PJM Interconnection, where it owns about 9.7 GW, according to an application at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.

articles.title: BofA upgrades Ørsted outlook, cites diminishing offshore wind risk from Trump
articles.summary: Bank of America analyst Peter Bisztyga said the risks facing Ørsted’s U.S. projects "have significantly diminished in the last few weeks."

articles.title: Oncor, LCRA propose up to 244 miles of 765-kV Texas transmission
articles.summary: The proposal supports Texas’ effort to build a network of high-voltage transmission lines to serve growing demand in the Permian Basin.

articles.title: Large load tariffs proliferate as states take more active role in data center regulation
articles.summary: In 2025, state regulators approved 29 large load tariffs, and more are on the way. Experts say it’s too soon to know if the tariffs are working as intended, but utilities should prepare for tougher scrutiny amid affordability concerns.

articles.title: Generation declined 0.7% year over year in January while prices went up 9.5%
articles.summary: In the Northeast, January generation increased 8.2% year over year due to cooler temperatures. But most of the country saw temperatures near average, above average, or — in the West — significantly above average.

articles.title: Before we build more gas pipelines, we need better data
articles.summary: Building energy infrastructure takes years, billions of dollars and massive political capital. Better data costs a fraction of that, write researchers at three universities.

articles.title: Ameren begins testing dynamic line rating technology
articles.summary: A pilot with Heimdall Power anticipates 30 sensor units that clamp directly onto transmission lines to monitor real-time conditions. Ameren said 15 have already been deployed to some of its most congested lines.

articles.title: AMP, ratepayer advocates oppose ROE, rates proposed for $1.1B AEP-FirstEnergy transmission project
articles.summary: The proposed rates fail to protect ratepayers from data center-driven transmission costs, the Office of the Ohio Consumers’ Counsel told the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.

articles.title: German energy minister calls nuclear phase-out 'huge mistake'
articles.summary: Katherina Reiche, Germany's economy and energy minister, discussed the likely impact on the country's economy if the Iran conflict continues - as well as the need for a "correction" to energy policies in Europe, at a conference in the USA.

articles.title: Planning for Swedish SMR plant proceeds
articles.summary: Swedish lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla said it plans to proceed with the next phase of planning for a power plant in Norrsundet, Gävle, in east central Sweden, after initial assessments confirmed that the site offers suitable conditions.

articles.title: X-energy, Talen to assess deployment of multiple SMR plants
articles.summary: US advanced nuclear technology developer X-energy Reactor Company has signed a Letter of Intent with Talen Energy Corporation to assess deploying X-energy's XE-100 small modular reactors in Pennsylvania and across the PJM Interconnection Regional Transmission Organization market.

articles.title: Aalo completes assembly of experimental reactor
articles.summary: Aalo Atomics has held a ceremony to unveil its completed Critical Test Reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory. The company said it expects the reactor to achieve criticality "well before" the 4 July deadline.

articles.title: Early construction landmarks for Chinese units
articles.summary: The giant CA20 structural module of Bailong nuclear power plant's unit 1 has been lifted into place - and the first steam generator moved into position at Lufeng nuclear power plant's unit 6.

articles.title: Vietnam, Russia sign agreement on new nuclear plant
articles.summary: An intergovernmental agreement has been signed on cooperation in the construction of the Ninh Thuan 1 Nuclear Power Plant in Vietnam, to feature two VVER‑1200 reactors, with the new Leningrad units as the reference project.

articles.title: Application submitted for Swedish SMR plant
articles.summary: Kärnfull Next has submitted an application to build a power plant based on small modular reactors in the municipality of Valdemarsvik in Östergötland county in southeastern Sweden. It is the first application under the country’s new Act on Government Approval of Nuclear Facilities.

articles.title: Uzbekistan and Russia mark SMR construction progress
articles.summary: Russia and Uzbekistan have signed a roadmap for nuclear cooperation, as initial concrete was poured as part of preparations for the construction of the first small modular reactor at Uzbekistan’s first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: Excavation work approved for India's Mahi Banswara units
articles.summary: India's Atomic Energy Regulatory Board has approved the start of activities towards excavation for construction of the Mahi Banswara Rajasthan Atomic Nuclear Power Project units 1 and 2.

articles.title: Containment tests completed at Sanmen 3
articles.summary: Tests to check the integrity of the containment structure have been completed at unit 3 of the Sanmen nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: In Pictures: Akkuyu 2's polar crane installed
articles.summary: The main part of the polar crane for unit 2 at Turkey's Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant been installed in position, at a height of 38.5 metres using a heavy-duty self-propelled crawler crane.

articles.title: Rooppur 1 boron flushes completed, ahead of fuel loading
articles.summary: Bangladesh's first nuclear power reactor has taken a fresh step towards starting up, after the successful completion of boron flushing of the first unit's primary circuit piping systems.

articles.title: Application lodged for Poland's first nuclear power plant
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has submitted an application to Poland's National Atomic Energy Agency for a construction permit for the country's first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: South Africa's Necsa seeks SMR partnership
articles.summary: The South African Nuclear Energy Corporation has launched an Expression of Interest process which "aims to identify capable technology partners … to advance a fit-for-purpose SMR technology for future deployment".

articles.title: 'Projectile' hit 350 metres from Bushehr nuclear reactor - IAEA
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency has said that "following information from Iran of a projectile incident on Tuesday evening, the IAEA can confirm that a structure 350 metres from the Bushehr NPP reactor was hit and destroyed".

articles.title: Poland’s radioactive waste management reviewed by IAEA mission
articles.summary: An International Atomic Energy Agency team of experts has praised progress made by Poland in safely managing its radioactive waste, and recommended further steps as the country moves ahead with its nuclear power programme.

articles.title: Licensing of Oklo pilot reactor facilities advances
articles.summary: Nuclear technology company Oklo has received US Department of Energy approval for the Nuclear Safety Design Agreements for both its first Aurora powerhouse at Idaho National Laboratory and Atomic Alchemy's Groves Isotopes Test Reactor in Texas. Atomic Alchemy has also been granted a materials licence for the isotope reactor.

articles.title: Work begins on solar power supply at Chernobyl
articles.summary: Preparatory work has begun for installing solar panels which the operators of the Chernobyl plant site say will help meet energy needs if external power is lost.

articles.title: Hunterston B site relicensed for decommissioning
articles.summary: The UK's Office for Nuclear Regulation has formally approved the relicensing of the Hunterston B nuclear power plant in North Ayrshire, Scotland - from EDF to Nuclear Restoration Services - marking the beginning of the site's decommissioning phase.

articles.title: Finland looks to reform nuclear energy legislation
articles.summary: In a move aimed at streamlining regulation and licensing of future nuclear power projects, the Finnish government has submitted a proposal to parliament for a new Nuclear Energy Act.
